draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.45, the 12th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 2nd of 26 at LB. He went 15th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Nolan Smith. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 61 tackles in 2024, 18th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons (reserve). 15 career games and 9 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 2.7% (85th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 edge rusher who played: 5.5 sacks against a median of 1.0, above the norm.
